name: Elad Meged
biography: Elad Meged is a Founding Engineer and Security Researcher at Novee Security, specializing in offensive security research and AI security. He holds an M.Sc. in Computer Science and has a background in vulnerability research across web, mobile, and low-level systems, with experience in reverse engineering and platform internals. His current work applies offensive research methodology to AI systems while developing AI-driven approaches to vulnerability discovery and exploit verification.
